description: This is the main Flutter application file defining the entry point, application widget, and home page. It sets up a simple UI with a title, a message indicating app generation, and a progress indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, sets up MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home screen, displaying a message and a loading indicator.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage, builds the scaffold containing app bar and body.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes and runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and MyHomePage.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MyHomePage widget.
